test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under which plan, for the first time, was the private sector given priority over the public sector?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Seventh Five-Year Plan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **Seventh Five Year Plan** (1985 - 1990) private sector got the priority over public sector for the first time in the history of economic planning in India.
 
• Its main aim was **poverty eradication and technological self dependency.**
 
• **The plan laid stress on improving the productivity level of industries by upgrading technology**. 
 
• The Seventh Plan aims at increasing** the green revolution to new areas** between its emphasis on **raising the productivity of rice** in the eastern region and in rainfed and dryland agriculture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Second five year Plan **focused on the development of the public sector and "rapid Industrialisation"**.​ 
 
• Tenth Five-Year Plan was to** reduction of poverty rate by 5% by 2007**.
 
• The Sixth Five-Year Plan **marked the beginning of economic liberalisation**.
